title: DeWolfe--Gubser--Rosen zero-density EMD thermodynamics
summary: An owner-approved Chebyshev and independent-DOP853 reproduction of the two zero-density black-hole curves in Figure 3 of the bottom-up DeWolfe--Gubser--Rosen EMD model.

conventions.name: bulk theory and units
conventions.value: Five bulk dimensions, mostly-plus signature, L = 1 and kappa_5^2 = 1 before source rescalings
conventions.rationale: Fixes the canonical EMD action and dimensionless black-hole observables.

conventions.name: ensemble
conventions.value: Zero chemical potential with a neutral background and infinitesimal Maxwell linear response
conventions.rationale: Phase 5A does not solve charged black-hole backgrounds.

conventions.name: primary radial variables
conventions.value: x = z^(4-Delta_phi), u = x/x_H, phi = x_H u P(u), A = -log z + x_H^2 u^2 C(u)
conventions.rationale: The factorization fixes the unit scalar source and includes both physical endpoints.

conventions.name: Phase 5 boundary
conventions.value: Phase 5A targets both Figure 3 black-hole curves; Phase 5B later requires Figure 5 and the critical point, with Figure 4 diagnostic only
conventions.rationale: Records the owner's 2026-08-22 custom amendment without opening finite-density work.

parameters.name: gauge kinetic function
parameters.description: The source function entering the zero-density susceptibility integral.

parameters.name: spectral degrees
parameters.description: Aligned physical-horizon resolutions for the primary and refinement routes.

parameters.name: physical horizon targets
parameters.value: 20 values uniformly spaced in log(phi_0) from 1.5 to 7.5
parameters.description: The same neutral black-hole family used for source Figure 3.

parameters.name: source scale dictionary
parameters.description: Displayed source calibration values; their recorded rounding mismatch is not refitted.

equations.description: Frozen gauge kinetic function used in linear response.

equations.source_ref: Source Eqs. (27)-(29), transformed to conformal gauge.
Source Eq. (29), transformed to conformal gauge.

equations.expression: I = integral dz exp(-A)/f_EMD; chi_2/T^2 = 1/(2 I T^2)
equations.description: Zero-density Maxwell linear-response susceptibility in the source-normalized conformal gauge.

observables.name: temperature
observables.extraction: Use the exact-horizon h derivative and multiply the dimensionless result by lambda_T.

observables.name: normalized entropy density
observables.extraction: Evaluate the horizon area and apply lambda_s/lambda_T^3.

observables.name: normalized baryon susceptibility
observables.extraction: Evaluate the Maxwell integral and apply lambda_s/(lambda_T lambda_mu^2).

acceptance_criteria: All fourteen owner-approved algebra, solver, equation, constraint, endpoint, target, refinement, Maxwell, independent-route, source-figure, determinism, and privacy gates pass.
The eleven Figure 3 entropy and susceptibility anchors agree within absolute errors 0.15 and 0.005, respectively.
The complete result and model card were approved by the owner on 2026-08-22 without widening the zero-density Figure 3 claim.

tests.expected: The spectral, DOP853, Maxwell, refinement, source-figure, and failure gates pass.
The generated two-panel comparison and underlying numerical anchors satisfy the frozen Phase 5A contract.

claims.statement: The displayed DGR action, source functions, zero-density susceptibility formula, scale dictionary, and Figure 3 curves are established in the cited public source.
claims.evidence: DeWolfe, Gubser, and Rosen, arXiv:1012.1864v2, Eqs. (1)-(5), (27)-(29), (49)-(64), and Figure 3.

claims.statement: The HoloForge Chebyshev background and independent DOP853/Maxwell routes reproduce both selected DGR Figure 3 black-hole curves within the frozen Phase 5A contract.
claims.evidence: Fourteen passing algebra, equation, constraint, endpoint, target, refinement, Maxwell, independent-route, Figure 3, determinism, and privacy gates in tests/test_dewolfe_gubser_rosen_emd.py.

limitations: This is a phenomenological bottom-up model and no top-down embedding is claimed.
Phase 5A is restricted to zero chemical potential and does not calculate charged backgrounds, Figure 5, the critical point, or critical exponents.
Figure 4 is not a required future reproduction target; it may only diagnose charged-scan coverage or branch topology.
The source functions and scale constants were selected to approximate lattice curves, so reproducing the model is not empirical validation of QCD or the lattice analysis.
The Figure 3 reference records contain derived public vector-path anchors and exclude third-party lattice markers and raw source artwork.
The implementation and model card are AI-assisted; owner approval does not erase that provenance or broaden the reproduced claim.
